name: iteriodev_tailscale
description: Tailscale status and login for the head unit: talks to the iteriodev-tailscale tool over its LocalAPI socket, shows the login link as a QR code, renames the head unit on the tailnet; GPU renderer screen
author: IterioDev

store.description: Log the head unit in to your tailnet without a computer: shows Tailscale's state, the login link as a QR code to scan with your phone, the head unit's tailnet name and address, Rename (default mgu) and Log out. Needs the Tailscale tool from the same source.
